Using small on-premise language models to address size, cost, and privacy concerns in clinical deployment

screen.reason: The study evaluates a small language model framework incorporating dual retrieval-augmented generation (guidelines and similar patient exemplars) compared to baseline, evaluating both classification performance and clinician assessment of reasoning quality and safety.

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented generation with clinical guidelines and case-based exemplars
